description: 电子设备外壳（带4个螺丝柱）
description_en: An electronics enclosure with 4 screw bosses
code:
import cadquery as cq
import math

# === 参数 ===
width = 100      # 宽 (mm)
length = 70      # 长 (mm)
height = 30      # 高 (mm)
wall = 2         # 壁厚 (mm)
boss_od = 6      # 螺丝柱外径 (mm)
boss_id = 2.5    # 螺丝柱内孔 (mm)
corner_inset = 6 # 螺丝柱距角距离 (mm)
fillet_r = 3     # 外圆角 (mm)

# === 建模 ===
# 壳体
result = (
    cq.Workplane("XY")
    .box(width, length, height)
    .edges("|Z").fillet(fillet_r)
    .faces(">Z").shell(-wall)
)

# 螺丝柱
boss_x = width / 2 - corner_inset
boss_y = length / 2 - corner_inset
boss_h = height - wall

for x, y in [(boss_x, boss_y), (-boss_x, boss_y), (-boss_x, -boss_y), (boss_x, -boss_y)]:
    boss = (
        cq.Workplane("XY")
        .center(x, y)
        .circle(boss_od / 2)
        .extrude(boss_h)
        .faces(">Z").workplane()
        .hole(boss_id, boss_h)
    )
    result = result.union(boss)

show_object(result)
